comment: Manual sections used as citation sources, mapped to the verbatim heading title of that section in the raw user manual. The evidence is not uniform, and the difference is recorded here rather than smoothed over. Most section numbers also appear as a literal '§<section>' token in 05-user-manual-functional-inventory.md, but that extract collapses the symbol-editor block into the single interval §5.1.4.3.2.2.3.2–5: 5.1.4.3.2.2.3.4 and 5.1.4.3.2.2.3.5 therefore occur there only inside that interval and never as individual tokens, and 5.1.4.3.2.2.3.7 has no analysis token at all. Those three entries rest solely on the raw manual body heading line, which is the stronger witness in any case. source-index.md and reference-product-summary.md may only cite sections from this map; anything else must be labelled 新增设计.
manual: PIMCenter Designer P&ID V25R4.1 用户手册

sections.3.1.1: 管理模式与用户模式简介

notes: §6.2.2.2 P&ID 协同设计 exists only as a heading with no body text; it may be cited to record that absence, never as evidence of a collaboration capability.

§3.2.1 is the vendor's product blurb. It is the only place that claims automatic design-error checking and automatic BOM generation, which is why both capabilities are listed as undocumented in reference-product-summary.md.
The 符号管理 family §5.1.4.3.2.2.3.1-.7 is ordered: 符号新建 / 符号编辑 / 符号外形绘制 / 符号连接点定义 / 符号标签的添加 / 符号的更新 / 符号属性的修改. Cite drawing to .3.3 and connection points to .3.4.
